elements_selected.content: Implement the SPA navigation shell as a small (<100 loc) vanilla JS module loaded by base.html when theme.toml sets [spa] enabled=true. Intercepts same-origin <a> clicks, fetches next document, swaps the [data-zetl-volatile] element, updates title and history state. Bypasses on meta/ctrl/middle-click, target=_blank, cross-origin. Handles popstate. Re-executes inline <script> tags in swapped content.
